items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Yisho kubantwana bakwa-Israyeli ukuthi bangilethele umhlatshelo; kuwo wonke umuntu onikela ngenhliziyo yakhe ngokuzithandela, anothabatha umnikelo wami.
Nanku umnikelo eniyakuwuthatha kubo; igolide nesiliva nethusi,
nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo kakhulu, noboya bembuzi;
nezikhumba zezimvu ezidaywe zibomvu, nezikhumba zamatahasi, nokhuni lomtholo;
Amafutha okukhanyisa, izinongo zamafutha okugcoba nawempepho ethaphukayo;
amatshe e-shohamu namatshe okufakwa ku-efodi nasebhokisini.
Bangenzele indlu engcwele; ukuze ngihlale phakathi kwabo.
Njengakho konke engikubonisa khona, njengesifanekiso setabernakele nesifanekiso sezinto zonke zalo, niyakulenza kanjalo.
“Bayakuwenza umphongolo womuthi womtholo, ubude bawo bube yizingalo ezimbili nenxenye, ububanzi bawo bube yingalo nenxenye, ukuphakama kwawo kube yingalo nenxenye.
Ulimboze ngegolide elicwengekileyo, ulisibekele ngaphakathi nangaphandle, wenze phezu kwalo umqhele wegolide inhlangothi zonke.
Uwubumbele amasongo amane egolide, uwafake emagumbini omane; amasongo amabili abe kolunye uhlangothi lwawo, namasongo amabili kolunye uhlangothi lwawo.
Kumelwe wenze izinti ngokhuni lomtholo uzimboze ngegolide.
Kumelwe uzifake izinti emasongweni asezinhlangothini zomphongolo, ukuze umphongolo uthwalwe ngazo.
Izinti kumelwe zibe semasongweni omphongolo; zingasuswa kuwo.
Kumelwe ubeke ubufakazi engizokunika bona emkhunjini.
Uzakwenza isihlalo somusa ngegolide elicwengekileyo, ubude baso bube yizingalo ezimbili lengxenye, ububanzi baso bube yingalo eyodwa lengxenye.
Kumelwe wenze amakherubi amabili egolide; ulenze libe ngomsebenzi okhandiweyo, emaceleni omabili esihlalo somusa.
Wenze elinye ikherubi ngalapha, nelinye ikherubi ngalapha; wowenza amakherubi esesihlalweni somusa emikhawulweni yaso yomibili.
Amakherubi ayakwelula amaphiko awo phezulu, asibekele isihlalo somusa ngamaphiko awo, ubuso bawo bubhekane; emva kwesihlalo somusa kuyakuba ubuso bamakherubi.
Kumelwe ubeke isihlalo somusa phezu komphongolo; futhi emkhunjini kumelwe ubeke ubufakazi engizokunika bona.
Ngiyakuhlangana nawe lapho, ngikhulume nawe ngiphezu kwesihlalo somusa phakathi kwamakherubi amabili aphezu komphongolo wobufakazi ngakho konke engikuyala ngakho kubantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Kumelwe wenze itafula ngomuthi womtholo, ubude balo bube yizingalo ezimbili, ububanzi balo bube yingalo, nokuphakama kwalo kube yingalo nengxenye.
Kumelwe ulimboze ngegolide elihlanzekile futhi ulenzele umqhele wegolide nxazonke.
Kumelwe wenze kulo udini olungangobubanzi besandla nxazonke, futhi kumelwe wenze umqhele wegolide ophethelweni lwalo nxazonke.
Kumelwe ulenzele amasongo amane egolide, uwafake amasongo emagumbini omane asezinyaweni zalo zozine.
Amasongo ayakuba maqondana nomkhawulo, abe yizindawo zezinti zokuthwala itafula.
Kumelwe wenze izinti ngokhuni lomtholo uzimboze ngegolide, ukuze itafula lithwalwe ngazo.
Wenze izitsha zalo, nezinkezo zalo, nezitsha zalo, nezitsha zalo, kube khona phezu kwakho; ulenze ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Kumelwe ubeke isinkwa phambi kwami njalo etafuleni.
Uzakwenza uthi lwesibane ngegolide elicwengekileyo; uthi lwesibani malwenziwe ngomsebenzi okhandiweyo, isiqu salo, nezinti zalo, nezindebe zalo, namaqhina alo, nezimbali zalo kuvele kulo.
Futhi amagatsha ayisithupha ayophuma ezinhlangothini zalo; izingalo ezintathu zothi lwesibani ngalapha, nezingalo ezintathu zothi lwesibani ngalapha;

Izindebe ezintathu ezenziwe njenge-alimondi, zinesumpa neluba engalweni inye; nezindebe ezintathu ezifaniswa ne-alimondi kwenye ingalo, zinesumpa nembali; kanjalo nasezingalweni eziyisithupha eziphuma othini lwesibani.
Othini lwesibane kube khona izitsha ezine zama-alimondi, imiqumbe yazo nezimbali zazo.

Futhi kumelwe kube khona inkinobho ngaphansi kwezingalo ezimbili ezifanayo, nenkinobho ngaphansi kwezingalo ezimbili ezifanayo, nenkinobho ngaphansi kwezingalo ezimbili ezifanayo, ngokwezingalo eziyisithupha eziphuma othini lwesibani.
Amafindo nezingalo zawo kufanele kube yinto efanayo; konke kuyakuba ngumkhando munye wegolide elicwengekileyo.
Kumelwe wenze izibani eziyisikhombisa ngalo, futhi kumelwe zikhanyise izibani zalo, ukuze zikhanyise kulo.
Izidlawu zalo nezingcwecwe zalo zamafinyila kumelwe kube ngegolide elihlanzekileyo.
Kumelwe asenze ngetalenta legolide elihlanzekile, kanye nazo zonke lezi zitsha.
Futhi bheka ukuthi ulenze ngokwesibonelo sabo owasiboniswa entabeni.
